title: Neighbour Who Fixes Bikes
setting: The child's bike broke and an adult neighbour on the same floor offered to repair it. The DM is about when the child can drop it off.

title: Cha Chaan Teng Waiter Regular
setting: The child's family often eats at a cha chaan teng, and the young waiter there found the child on Instagram. The chat started about the daily specials and a drink promotion.

title: Public Library Teen Zone Volunteer
setting: The child studies in a library teen zone and a regular volunteer, who runs a games hour, messaged about the next session. The thread is about board game picks.

title: Online Book Club Co-member
setting: Both joined an online teen book club and the other person messaged about a book chapter discussion. They have never met in person.

title: Gaming Forum Stranger
setting: The child asked for help in an online game forum and a stranger offered advice. The DM is about a boss fight strategy.
